title: The FDA-Approved Drug That Turned Eyes Black
hook: Thousands of people took a common prescription medication—and their eyeballs started turning permanently black from the inside out.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visually disturbing and rare—creates immediate shock and the desire to identify the drug.

title: The Nurse Who Injected Air Into 60 Patients' Veins
hook: She was known as the 'Angel of Death'—a nurse who killed over 60 patients by injecting bubbles into their IV lines, and no one suspected for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Serial killer in a setting of trust—deeply unsettling and highly shareable.

title: The Experiments That Made Orphans Drink Radioactive Milk
hook: Inside a state-run orphanage, children were fed radioactive milk every day for a 'nutrition study'—their bones never stopped glowing.
why_this_can_go_viral: Children as lab rats triggers moral outrage and makes people want to expose the story.

title: The Suppressed Cure: Baking Soda Stopped Kidney Failure
hook: A cheap box of baking soda reversed late-stage kidney disease in 80% of patients—until the study was shut down and never repeated.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme contrast between low cost and high efficacy—activates distrust of the medical system.

title: The Toxic Baby Oil That Caused Organ Failure
hook: A popular baby oil was found to contain a chemical that attacks the liver—and it stayed on shelves for 15 years after the first death.
why_this_can_go_viral: Targets parents directly—fear for children’s safety drives massive sharing.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How Autism Was Linked to Factory Smoke
hook: For 20 years, a chemical plant knew their emissions were causing autism in nearby children—and buried every single report.
why_this_can_go_viral: Links a controversial condition to corporate greed—taps into environmental and parenting fears.

title: The Dentist Who Removed Patients' Teeth While They Were Awake—For Fun
hook: He pulled over 200 teeth from conscious patients in one week, recording their screams—and called it 'entertainment.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme physical horror in a routine setting—triggers visceral revulsion and curiosity.

title: The Drug Company That Made an 'Addiction Vaccine'—Then Buried It
hook: A vaccine that stopped opioid addiction in 90% of patients was developed—and then the company shelved it forever because it hurt profits.
why_this_can_go_viral: High emotional stake—saving lives vs. profit—generates anger and shareability.

title: The Hospital That Harvested Skin from Living Patients
hook: Doctors at a city hospital were peeling skin from conscious patients without anesthesia—and selling it for grafts.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines body horror with institutional betrayal—viewers will feel visceral disgust.

title: The Experiment That Wired Orphans' Brains to Shock Machines
hook: In a secret study, children were strapped to chairs and given electric shocks to 'measure brain development'—the data was never released.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme cruelty against children automatically generates outrage and demands exposure.

title: The Suppressed Cure: Vitamin C Drops Reversed Blindness
hook: A simple vitamin C eye drop restored full vision in patients with cataracts—the patent was bought and locked in a safe forever.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visceral hope crushed by corporate greed—triggers anger and desire to share the 'secret.'

title: The Toxic Laundry Detergent That Gave Children Chemical Pneumonia
hook: A popular laundry detergent was filling children's lungs with fluid—hospitals saw an epidemic, but the company denied everything.
why_this_can_go_viral: Targets a universal household item—creates immediate fear and checking behavior.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How Aspartame Was Linked to Brain Tumors
hook: Internal documents proved aspartame caused brain tumors in 80% of test animals—the company paid scientists to lie, and it's still in your soda.
why_this_can_go_viral: Touches a universally consumed product—everyone feels personally exposed and betrayed.

title: The Doctor Who Gave Patients Fake Chemotherapy for Profit
hook: A respected oncologist was injecting cancer patients with salt water instead of chemo—and billing hundreds of thousands per dose.
why_this_can_go_viral: Exploits the most vulnerable patients—cancer—and triggers profound moral outrage.

title: The Hospital That Chained Patients to Radiators for 'Therapy'
hook: In a state-funded hospital, mental patients were chained to hot radiators as 'treatment'—some were left there for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Sensory image of extreme suffering—makes viewers want to witness the horror.

title: The FDA-Approved Arthritis Drug That Made Bones Dissolve
hook: A top arthritis medication caused patients' jawbones to literally dissolve—and it was prescribed to millions before the warning came.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual and physical horror—'your jaw melting' is an unforgettable image.

title: The Suppressed Cure: Garlic Stopped Antibiotic-Resistant Infections
hook: A concentrated garlic extract killed every superbug it was tested against—but no hospital will use it because it can't be patented.
why_this_can_go_viral: Simple, natural solution vs. system—activates anti-establishment sharing.

title: The Toxic Hand Sanitizer That Gave Children Seizures
hook: A popular hand sanitizer sold in schools contained a chemical that triggered seizures in dozens of kids—and it was still sold for months.
why_this_can_go_viral: Targets parents and schools—fear of hidden danger in everyday products.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How Teflon Gave Thousands Cancer
hook: DuPont knew Teflon caused cancer for 40 years—they hid the data while non-stick pans poisoned entire communities.
why_this_can_go_viral: Infamous scandal with wide personal relevance—everyone has non-stick pans.

title: The Doctor Who Removed Patients' Lungs for 'Research'
hook: A surgeon was removing healthy lungs from living patients during 'routine' procedures—and selling them to research labs.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme violation of trust—makes viewers question every surgery.
